double-iron-bash.descriptionEn: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.

max-guard.name: max-guard
max-guard.descriptionEs: Frena todos los ataques, pero puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.
max-guard.descriptionEn: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

dynamax-cannon.name: dynamax-cannon
dynamax-cannon.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca emitiendo un rayo desde su núcleo. El daño infligido se duplica si el objetivo ha alcanzado el estado Dinamax.
dynamax-cannon.descriptionEn: The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage.

snipe-shot.name: snipe-shot
snipe-shot.descriptionEs: Permite atacar al objetivo seleccionado ignorando las habilidades o movimientos que permiten a un rival centrar la atención sobre sí.
snipe-shot.descriptionEn: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

jaw-lock.name: jaw-lock
jaw-lock.descriptionEs: Impide que tanto el atacante como el defensor puedan ser intercambiados hasta que uno de ellos se debilite o abandone el terreno de combate.
jaw-lock.descriptionEn: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

stuff-cheeks.name: stuff-cheeks
stuff-cheeks.descriptionEs: El usuario ingiere la baya que lleva equipada para aumentar mucho su Defensa.
stuff-cheeks.descriptionEn: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

no-retreat.name: no-retreat
no-retreat.descriptionEs: El usuario aumenta todas sus características, pero ya no puede huir ni ser cambiado por otro.
no-retreat.descriptionEn: This move boosts all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

tar-shot.name: tar-shot
tar-shot.descriptionEs: Cubre al objetivo de un alquitrán pegajoso que reduce su Velocidad y lo vuelve débil contra el fuego.
tar-shot.descriptionEn: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.

octolock.name: octolock
octolock.descriptionEs: Retiene al objetivo para impedir su huida, a la vez que reduce su Defensa y Defensa Especial cada turno.
octolock.descriptionEn: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def every turn.

magic-powder.name: magic-powder
magic-powder.descriptionEs: Cubre al objetivo con unos polvos mágicos que le hacen adquirir el tipo Psíquico.
magic-powder.descriptionEn: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target's type to Psychic.

bolt-beak.name: bolt-beak
bolt-beak.descriptionEs: El usuario ensarta al objetivo con su pico cargado de electricidad. Si ataca en primer lugar, la potencia del movimiento se duplica.
bolt-beak.descriptionEn: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

dragon-darts.name: dragon-darts
dragon-darts.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca propulsando a ambos Dreepy. En caso de haber dos adversarios, cada Dreepy golpea a su propio objetivo por separado.
dragon-darts.descriptionEn: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.

fishious-rend.name: fishious-rend
fishious-rend.descriptionEs: El usuario agarra al objetivo con sus duras branquias. En caso de atacar antes que este último, la potencia del movimiento se duplica.
fishious-rend.descriptionEn: The user rends the target with its hard gills. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

court-change.name: court-change
court-change.descriptionEs: Extraño poder que intercambia los efectos en el terreno de combate de ambos bandos.
court-change.descriptionEn: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

teatime.name: teatime
teatime.descriptionEs: El usuario invita a tomar el té a todos los presentes en el terreno de combate, lo que hace que ingieran las bayas que lleven equipadas.
teatime.descriptionEn: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

max-flare.name: max-flare
max-flare.descriptionEs: Ataque de tipo Fuego ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Hace que se intensifique el efecto del sol durante cinco turnos.
max-flare.descriptionEn: This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user intensifies the sun for five turns.

max-flutterby.name: max-flutterby
max-flutterby.descriptionEs: Ataque de tipo Bicho ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Reduce el Ataque Especial del objetivo.
max-flutterby.descriptionEn: This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

max-lightning.name: max-lightning
max-lightning.descriptionEs: Ataque de tipo Eléctrico ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea un campo eléctrico durante cinco turnos.
max-lightning.descriptionEn: This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns.

max-phantasm.name: max-phantasm
max-phantasm.descriptionEs: Ataque de tipo Fantasma ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Reduce la Defensa de los rivales.
max-phantasm.descriptionEn: This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Defense stat.

max-knuckle.descriptionEn: This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.

max-hailstorm.descriptionEs: Ataque de tipo Hielo ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea una tormenta de granizo que dura cinco turnos.
max-hailstorm.descriptionEn: This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.

max-ooze.descriptionEn: This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.

max-airstream.descriptionEn: This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.

max-geyser.name: max-geyser

max-geyser.descriptionEn: This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns.

max-starfall.name: max-starfall
max-starfall.descriptionEs: Ataque de tipo Hada ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea un campo de niebla durante cinco turnos.
max-starfall.descriptionEn: This is a Fairy-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for five turns.

max-rockfall.descriptionEn: This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.

clangorous-soul.name: clangorous-soul
clangorous-soul.descriptionEs: Utiliza parte de los PS propios para subir sus características.
clangorous-soul.descriptionEn: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.

decorate.name: decorate
decorate.descriptionEs: Aumenta mucho el Ataque y el Ataque Especial del objetivo al decorarlo.
decorate.descriptionEn: The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

drum-beating.name: drum-beating
drum-beating.descriptionEs: El usuario controla un tocón mediante la percusión y al atacar reduce la Velocidad del objetivo.
drum-beating.descriptionEn: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

snap-trap.name: snap-trap
snap-trap.descriptionEs: Cepo que atrapa al objetivo durante cuatro o cinco turnos y le causa daño mientras se encuentra preso.
snap-trap.descriptionEn: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.

pyro-ball.name: pyro-ball
pyro-ball.descriptionEs: El usuario prende una pequeña piedra para crear una bola de fuego con la que ataca al rival. Puede causar quemaduras.
pyro-ball.descriptionEn: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

body-press.name: body-press
body-press.descriptionEs: El usuario usa el cuerpo para lanzar su ataque e infligir un daño directamente proporcional a su Defensa.
body-press.descriptionEn: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

behemoth-blade.name: behemoth-blade
behemoth-blade.descriptionEs: El usuario se convierte en una espada gigante para rebanar al objetivo. Si este ha alcanzado el estado Dinamax, se duplica el daño infligido.
behemoth-blade.descriptionEn: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

behemoth-bash.name: behemoth-bash
behemoth-bash.descriptionEs: El usuario se convierte en un escudo gigante para golpear al objetivo. Si este ha alcanzado el estado Dinamax, se duplica el daño infligido.
behemoth-bash.descriptionEn: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

aura-wheel.name: aura-wheel
aura-wheel.descriptionEs: La energía que acumula en las mejillas le sirve para atacar y aumentar su Velocidad. Este movimiento cambia de tipo según la forma que adopte Morpeko.
aura-wheel.descriptionEn: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.

branch-poke.name: branch-poke
branch-poke.descriptionEs: Ataca pinchando al objetivo con una rama afilada.
branch-poke.descriptionEn: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

breaking-swipe.name: breaking-swipe
breaking-swipe.descriptionEs: El usuario sacude violentamente su enorme cola para golpear a todos los rivales y reducir su Ataque a la par.
breaking-swipe.descriptionEn: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

overdrive.name: overdrive
overdrive.descriptionEs: El usuario rasguea la guitarra o el bajo para generar enormes vibraciones de intensa reverberación con las que ataca al objetivo.
overdrive.descriptionEn: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

apple-acid.name: apple-acid
apple-acid.descriptionEs: Ataca al objetivo con el fluido corrosivo que desprende una manzana ácida, lo que también disminuye la Defensa Especial de este.
apple-acid.descriptionEn: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

grav-apple.name: grav-apple
grav-apple.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca haciendo caer una manzana desde gran altura. Disminuye la Defensa del objetivo.
grav-apple.descriptionEn: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

spirit-break.name: spirit-break
spirit-break.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca al objetivo con tal ímpetu que acaba minando su moral y, en consecuencia, reduce su Ataque Especial.
spirit-break.descriptionEn: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

strange-steam.name: strange-steam
strange-steam.descriptionEs: Desprende un humo con el que ataca al objetivo, que puede acabar confundido.
strange-steam.descriptionEn: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

obstruct.name: obstruct
obstruct.descriptionEs: Frena todos los ataques, pero puede fallar si se usa repetidamente. Reduce mucho la Defensa de quien ejecute un movimiento de contacto contra el usuario.
obstruct.descriptionEn: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.

false-surrender.name: false-surrender
false-surrender.descriptionEs: El usuario finge hacer una reverencia y aprovecha la ocasión para ensartar al objetivo con su cabello alborotado. Siempre acierta.
false-surrender.descriptionEn: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

meteor-assault.name: meteor-assault
meteor-assault.descriptionEs: El usuario agita violentamente su grueso puerro para atacar, pero el mareo que le provocan las sacudidas le impide moverse en el turno siguiente.
meteor-assault.descriptionEn: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.

eternabeam.name: eternabeam
eternabeam.descriptionEs: Este es el mayor ataque de Eternatus una vez adquirida su forma original. No puede moverse en el turno siguiente.
eternabeam.descriptionEn: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.

life-dew.name: life-dew
life-dew.descriptionEs: Vierte un agua misteriosa y balsámica que restaura tanto sus propios PS como los de aquellos aliados presentes en el terreno de combate.
life-dew.descriptionEn: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

steel-beam.name: steel-beam
steel-beam.descriptionEs: Utiliza el acero de su cuerpo para disparar un potente rayo. También hiere al agresor.
steel-beam.descriptionEn: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

steel-roller.name: steel-roller
steel-roller.descriptionEs: El usuario lanza su ataque y destruye el campo activo en el terreno de combate, y falla si no hay ninguno en ese momento.
steel-roller.descriptionEn: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.

expanding-force.name: expanding-force
expanding-force.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca al objetivo con sus poderes psíquicos. Cuando se usa en conjunción con un campo psíquico, aumenta su potencia e inflige daño a todos los rivales.
expanding-force.descriptionEn: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

scale-shot.name: scale-shot
scale-shot.descriptionEs: Lanza escamas al objetivo de dos a cinco veces seguidas. Aumenta la Velocidad del usuario, pero reduce su Defensa.
scale-shot.descriptionEn: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

shell-side-arm.name: shell-side-arm
shell-side-arm.descriptionEs: El usuario lanza un ataque físico o especial en función de cuál inflija más daño. Puede envenenar al objetivo.
shell-side-arm.descriptionEn: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This may also poison the target.

meteor-beam.name: meteor-beam
meteor-beam.descriptionEs: El usuario dedica el primer turno a aumentar su Ataque Especial acumulando energía cósmica y lanza su ofensiva contra el objetivo en el segundo.
meteor-beam.descriptionEn: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

misty-explosion.name: misty-explosion
misty-explosion.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca a todos a su alrededor, pero se debilita de inmediato. La potencia del movimiento aumenta si el terreno está cubierto por un campo de niebla.
misty-explosion.descriptionEn: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.

grassy-glide.name: grassy-glide
grassy-glide.descriptionEs: Ataca al objetivo deslizándose sobre el terreno de combate. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta cuando el terreno está cubierto por un campo de hierba.
grassy-glide.descriptionEn: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

rising-voltage.name: rising-voltage
rising-voltage.descriptionEs: Ataca con una descarga eléctrica que surge del terreno de combate. La potencia del movimiento se duplica si el rival se ve afectado por un campo eléctrico.
rising-voltage.descriptionEn: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.

terrain-pulse.name: terrain-pulse
terrain-pulse.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca aprovechando la energía del campo activo, que determina tanto el tipo como la potencia del movimiento.
terrain-pulse.descriptionEn: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

skitter-smack.name: skitter-smack
skitter-smack.descriptionEs: Ataca al objetivo por la espalda de forma subrepticia y además reduce su Ataque Especial.
skitter-smack.descriptionEn: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

burning-jealousy.name: burning-jealousy
burning-jealousy.descriptionEs: Ataca al objetivo con la energía generada por la envidia y causa quemaduras a los Pokémon cuyas características hayan aumentado en ese turno.
burning-jealousy.descriptionEn: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

poltergeist.name: poltergeist
poltergeist.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca utilizando el objeto que lleva el rival. Si no tiene ninguno equipado, el movimiento falla.
poltergeist.descriptionEn: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.

corrosive-gas.name: corrosive-gas
corrosive-gas.descriptionEs: El usuario libera un gas cáustico que envuelve a todos los que se encuentren alrededor y derrite por completo los objetos que lleven equipados.
corrosive-gas.descriptionEn: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

triple-axel.name: triple-axel
triple-axel.descriptionEs: Patea hasta tres veces seguidas y cada vez más fuerte.
triple-axel.descriptionEn: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

lash-out.name: lash-out
lash-out.descriptionEs: Ataca al rival presa de la rabia. Si el usuario ha sufrido una reducción de características en ese turno, la potencia del movimiento se duplica.
lash-out.descriptionEn: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.

flip-turn.name: flip-turn
flip-turn.descriptionEs: Tras atacar, el usuario da paso a toda prisa a otro Pokémon del equipo.
flip-turn.descriptionEn: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

dual-wingbeat.name: dual-wingbeat
dual-wingbeat.descriptionEs: Ataca al adversario golpeándolo dos veces con las alas.
dual-wingbeat.descriptionEn: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

jungle-healing.name: jungle-healing
jungle-healing.descriptionEs: Al entrar en plena armonía con la selva, el usuario cura problemas de estado y restaura PS no solo de sí mismo, sino también de los aliados presentes en el terreno.
jungle-healing.descriptionEn: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

coaching.name: coaching
coaching.descriptionEs: El usuario imparte indicaciones precisas a sus aliados, que ven aumentados su Ataque y su Defensa.
coaching.descriptionEn: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

wicked-blow.name: wicked-blow
wicked-blow.descriptionEs: Golpe devastador que requiere un absoluto dominio de las artes siniestras. Siempre asesta un golpe crítico.
wicked-blow.descriptionEn: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

thunder-cage.name: thunder-cage
thunder-cage.descriptionEs: El objetivo queda atrapado en una jaula electrificada que permanece en el terreno de cuatro a cinco turnos.
thunder-cage.descriptionEn: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

scorching-sands.name: scorching-sands
scorching-sands.descriptionEs: Ataca al objetivo arrojándole arena a temperaturas muy elevadas. Puede causar quemaduras.
scorching-sands.descriptionEn: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

dragon-energy.name: dragon-energy
dragon-energy.descriptionEs: El usuario convierte su fuerza vital en una energía con la que ataca al objetivo. Cuantos menos PS tenga el usuario, menor será la potencia del movimiento.
dragon-energy.descriptionEn: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

surging-strikes.name: surging-strikes
surging-strikes.descriptionEs: El usuario, dominador absoluto del líquido elemento, golpea hasta tres veces con movimientos fluidos. Siempre asesta un golpe crítico.
surging-strikes.descriptionEn: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.

freezing-glare.name: freezing-glare
freezing-glare.descriptionEs: A través de sus ojos emite poderes psíquicos con los que ataca al objetivo, al que puede llegar a congelar.
freezing-glare.descriptionEn: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

fiery-wrath.name: fiery-wrath
fiery-wrath.descriptionEs: El usuario convierte su ira en un aura flamígera para lanzar su ataque. Puede amedrentar al objetivo.
fiery-wrath.descriptionEn: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

thunderous-kick.name: thunderous-kick
thunderous-kick.descriptionEs: El usuario desconcierta al rival con movimientos centelleantes y le propina una patada. Baja la Defensa del objetivo.
thunderous-kick.descriptionEn: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

glacial-lance.name: glacial-lance
glacial-lance.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca al objetivo lanzándole un carámbano de hielo envuelto en una ventisca.
glacial-lance.descriptionEn: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

astral-barrage.name: astral-barrage
astral-barrage.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca al objetivo lanzándole una ingente cantidad de pequeños fantasmas.
astral-barrage.descriptionEn: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

eerie-spell.name: eerie-spell
eerie-spell.descriptionEs: El usuario ataca con un poder psíquico de inmensa potencia y elimina 3 PP del último movimiento que haya usado el objetivo.
eerie-spell.descriptionEn: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.

dire-claw.name: dire-claw
dire-claw.descriptionEs: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.
dire-claw.descriptionEn: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

psyshield-bash.name: psyshield-bash
psyshield-bash.descriptionEs: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.
psyshield-bash.descriptionEn: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.

springtide-storm.name: springtide-storm
springtide-storm.descriptionEs: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.
springtide-storm.descriptionEn: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.

power-shift.name: power-shift
power-shift.descriptionEs: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.
power-shift.descriptionEn: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

stone-axe.name: stone-axe
stone-axe.descriptionEs: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.
stone-axe.descriptionEn: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.

mystical-power.name: mystical-power
mystical-power.descriptionEs: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
mystical-power.descriptionEn: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

raging-fury.name: raging-fury
raging-fury.descriptionEs: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
raging-fury.descriptionEn: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

wave-crash.name: wave-crash
wave-crash.descriptionEs: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.
wave-crash.descriptionEn: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

chloroblast.name: chloroblast
chloroblast.descriptionEs: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.
chloroblast.descriptionEn: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

mountain-gale.name: mountain-gale
mountain-gale.descriptionEs: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.
mountain-gale.descriptionEn: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.

headlong-rush.name: headlong-rush
headlong-rush.descriptionEs: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
headlong-rush.descriptionEn: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

barb-barrage.name: barb-barrage
barb-barrage.descriptionEs: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.
barb-barrage.descriptionEn: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

esper-wing.name: esper-wing
esper-wing.descriptionEs: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
esper-wing.descriptionEn: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

shelter.name: shelter
shelter.descriptionEs: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
shelter.descriptionEn: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

bitter-malice.name: bitter-malice
bitter-malice.descriptionEs: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
bitter-malice.descriptionEn: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

victory-dance.name: victory-dance
victory-dance.descriptionEs: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.
victory-dance.descriptionEn: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

triple-arrows.name: triple-arrows
triple-arrows.descriptionEs: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.
triple-arrows.descriptionEn: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.

infernal-parade.name: infernal-parade
infernal-parade.descriptionEs: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.
infernal-parade.descriptionEn: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

ceaseless-edge.name: ceaseless-edge
ceaseless-edge.descriptionEs: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.
ceaseless-edge.descriptionEn: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

wildbolt-storm.name: wildbolt-storm
wildbolt-storm.descriptionEs: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.
wildbolt-storm.descriptionEn: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

sandsear-storm.name: sandsear-storm
sandsear-storm.descriptionEs: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.
sandsear-storm.descriptionEn: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.

bleakwind-storm.name: bleakwind-storm
bleakwind-storm.descriptionEs: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.
bleakwind-storm.descriptionEn: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.

lunar-blessing.name: lunar-blessing
lunar-blessing.descriptionEs: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
lunar-blessing.descriptionEn: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

take-heart.name: take-heart
take-heart.descriptionEs: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
take-heart.descriptionEn: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

silk-trap.name: silk-trap
silk-trap.descriptionEs: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.
silk-trap.descriptionEn: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

axe-kick.name: axe-kick
axe-kick.descriptionEs: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.
axe-kick.descriptionEn: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

last-respects.name: last-respects
last-respects.descriptionEs: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.
last-respects.descriptionEn: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.

lumina-crash.name: lumina-crash
lumina-crash.descriptionEs: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
lumina-crash.descriptionEn: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

order-up.name: order-up
order-up.descriptionEs: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.
order-up.descriptionEn: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.

jet-punch.name: jet-punch
jet-punch.descriptionEs: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
jet-punch.descriptionEn: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

spicy-extract.name: spicy-extract
spicy-extract.descriptionEs: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.
spicy-extract.descriptionEn: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.

spin-out.name: spin-out
spin-out.descriptionEs: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.
spin-out.descriptionEn: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

population-bomb.name: population-bomb
population-bomb.descriptionEs: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.
population-bomb.descriptionEn: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

glaive-rush.name: glaive-rush
glaive-rush.descriptionEs: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.
glaive-rush.descriptionEn: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

revival-blessing.name: revival-blessing
revival-blessing.descriptionEs: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.
revival-blessing.descriptionEn: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

salt-cure.name: salt-cure
salt-cure.descriptionEs: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.
salt-cure.descriptionEn: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

triple-dive.name: triple-dive
triple-dive.descriptionEs: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.
triple-dive.descriptionEn: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

mortal-spin.name: mortal-spin
mortal-spin.descriptionEs: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.
mortal-spin.descriptionEn: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

ice-spinner.name: ice-spinner
ice-spinner.descriptionEs: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.
ice-spinner.descriptionEn: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

doodle.name: doodle
doodle.descriptionEs: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.
doodle.descriptionEn: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

fillet-away.name: fillet-away
fillet-away.descriptionEs: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.
fillet-away.descriptionEn: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

kowtow-cleave.name: kowtow-cleave
kowtow-cleave.descriptionEs: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.
kowtow-cleave.descriptionEn: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

flower-trick.name: flower-trick
flower-trick.descriptionEs: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.
flower-trick.descriptionEn: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

torch-song.name: torch-song
torch-song.descriptionEs: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
torch-song.descriptionEn: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

tera-blast.name: tera-blast
tera-blast.descriptionEs: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
tera-blast.descriptionEn: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

aqua-step.name: aqua-step
aqua-step.descriptionEs: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
aqua-step.descriptionEn: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

raging-bull.name: raging-bull
raging-bull.descriptionEs: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
raging-bull.descriptionEn: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

make-it-rain.name: make-it-rain
make-it-rain.descriptionEs: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.
make-it-rain.descriptionEn: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.

psyblade.name: psyblade
psyblade.descriptionEs: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.
psyblade.descriptionEn: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.

hydro-steam.name: hydro-steam
hydro-steam.descriptionEs: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.
hydro-steam.descriptionEn: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.

electro-drift.name: electro-drift
electro-drift.descriptionEs: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.
electro-drift.descriptionEn: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

ruination.name: ruination
ruination.descriptionEs: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.
ruination.descriptionEn: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

collision-course.name: collision-course
collision-course.descriptionEs: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.
collision-course.descriptionEn: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

shed-tail.name: shed-tail
shed-tail.descriptionEs: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
shed-tail.descriptionEn: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

chilly-reception.name: chilly-reception
chilly-reception.descriptionEs: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.
chilly-reception.descriptionEn: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

tidy-up.name: tidy-up
tidy-up.descriptionEs: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.
tidy-up.descriptionEn: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

snowscape.name: snowscape
snowscape.descriptionEs: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.
snowscape.descriptionEn: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

pounce.name: pounce
pounce.descriptionEs: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
pounce.descriptionEn: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

hyper-drill.name: hyper-drill
hyper-drill.descriptionEs: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
hyper-drill.descriptionEn: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

twin-beam.name: twin-beam
twin-beam.descriptionEs: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
twin-beam.descriptionEn: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

rage-fist.name: rage-fist
rage-fist.descriptionEs: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.
rage-fist.descriptionEn: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.

armor-cannon.name: armor-cannon
armor-cannon.descriptionEs: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
armor-cannon.descriptionEn: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

bitter-blade.name: bitter-blade
bitter-blade.descriptionEs: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
bitter-blade.descriptionEn: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

double-shock.name: double-shock
double-shock.descriptionEs: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.
double-shock.descriptionEn: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

gigaton-hammer.name: gigaton-hammer
gigaton-hammer.descriptionEs: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.
gigaton-hammer.descriptionEn: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.

comeuppance.name: comeuppance
comeuppance.descriptionEs: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
comeuppance.descriptionEn: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

aqua-cutter.name: aqua-cutter
aqua-cutter.descriptionEs: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
aqua-cutter.descriptionEn: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

blood-moon.name: blood-moon
blood-moon.descriptionEs: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.
blood-moon.descriptionEn: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.

matcha-gotcha.name: matcha-gotcha
matcha-gotcha.descriptionEs: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
matcha-gotcha.descriptionEn: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

chilling-water.name: chilling-water
chilling-water.descriptionEs: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
chilling-water.descriptionEn: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

trailblaze.name: trailblaze
trailblaze.descriptionEs: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
trailblaze.descriptionEn: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

syrup-bomb.name: syrup-bomb
syrup-bomb.descriptionEs: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.
syrup-bomb.descriptionEn: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

ivy-cudgel.name: ivy-cudgel
ivy-cudgel.descriptionEs: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
ivy-cudgel.descriptionEn: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

electro-shot.name: electro-shot
electro-shot.descriptionEs: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
electro-shot.descriptionEn: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

tera-starstorm.name: tera-starstorm
tera-starstorm.descriptionEs: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.
tera-starstorm.descriptionEn: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

fickle-beam.name: fickle-beam
fickle-beam.descriptionEs: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.
fickle-beam.descriptionEn: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

burning-bulwark.name: burning-bulwark
burning-bulwark.descriptionEs: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.
burning-bulwark.descriptionEn: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

thunderclap.name: thunderclap
thunderclap.descriptionEs: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
thunderclap.descriptionEn: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

mighty-cleave.name: mighty-cleave
mighty-cleave.descriptionEs: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
mighty-cleave.descriptionEn: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

tachyon-cutter.name: tachyon-cutter
tachyon-cutter.descriptionEs: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.
tachyon-cutter.descriptionEn: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

hard-press.name: hard-press
hard-press.descriptionEs: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
hard-press.descriptionEn: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

temper-flare.name: temper-flare
temper-flare.descriptionEs: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
temper-flare.descriptionEn: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

alluring-voice.name: alluring-voice
alluring-voice.descriptionEs: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
alluring-voice.descriptionEn: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

dragon-cheer.name: dragon-cheer
dragon-cheer.descriptionEs: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.
dragon-cheer.descriptionEn: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

supercell-slam.name: supercell-slam
supercell-slam.descriptionEs: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
supercell-slam.descriptionEn: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

psychic-noise.name: psychic-noise
psychic-noise.descriptionEs: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
psychic-noise.descriptionEn: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

malignant-chain.name: malignant-chain
malignant-chain.descriptionEs: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
malignant-chain.descriptionEn: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

shadow-rush.name: shadow-rush
shadow-rush.descriptionEs: Has an increased chance for a critical hit in Hyper Mode.
shadow-rush.descriptionEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit in Hyper Mode.

shadow-blast.name: shadow-blast
shadow-blast.descriptionEs: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
shadow-blast.descriptionEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

shadow-blitz.name: shadow-blitz
shadow-blitz.descriptionEs: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
shadow-blitz.descriptionEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

shadow-bolt.name: shadow-bolt
shadow-bolt.descriptionEs: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
shadow-bolt.descriptionEn: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

shadow-break.name: shadow-break
shadow-break.descriptionEs: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
shadow-break.descriptionEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

shadow-chill.name: shadow-chill
shadow-chill.descriptionEs: Has a chance to freeze the target.
shadow-chill.descriptionEn: Has a chance to freeze the target.

shadow-end.name: shadow-end
shadow-end.descriptionEs: User receives 1/2 its HP in recoil.
shadow-end.descriptionEn: User receives 1/2 its HP in recoil.

shadow-fire.name: shadow-fire
shadow-fire.descriptionEs: Has a chance to burn the target.
shadow-fire.descriptionEn: Has a chance to burn the target.

shadow-rave.name: shadow-rave
shadow-rave.descriptionEs: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
shadow-rave.descriptionEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

shadow-storm.name: shadow-storm
shadow-storm.descriptionEs: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
shadow-storm.descriptionEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

shadow-wave.name: shadow-wave
shadow-wave.descriptionEs: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
shadow-wave.descriptionEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

shadow-down.name: shadow-down
shadow-down.descriptionEs: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.
shadow-down.descriptionEn: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

shadow-half.name: shadow-half
shadow-half.descriptionEs: Halves HP of all Pokémon on the field. Must recharge
shadow-half.descriptionEn: Halves HP of all Pokémon on the field. Must recharge

shadow-hold.name: shadow-hold
shadow-hold.descriptionEs: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
shadow-hold.descriptionEn: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

shadow-mist.name: shadow-mist
shadow-mist.descriptionEs: Lowers the target’s evasion by two stages.
shadow-mist.descriptionEn: Lowers the target’s evasion by two stages.

shadow-shed.name: shadow-shed
shadow-shed.descriptionEs: Removes Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.
shadow-shed.descriptionEn: Removes Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

upper-hand.name: upper-hand
upper-hand.descriptionEs: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
upper-hand.descriptionEn: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

shadow-sky.name: shadow-sky
shadow-sky.descriptionEs: Changes the weather to Shadow Sky for five turns.
shadow-sky.descriptionEn: Changes the weather to Shadow Sky for five turns.
